content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [product_name] and have recently purchased a development kit for a traffic light control project. Yes, this is achievable. You can transmit events between two [product_name] units over the network in both directions. It's possible to set up the connection between two [product_name] units—such as [article_no] versions—using LAN, WLAN, or DLAN. analysis.insight_summary: The user is exploring how to network multiple [product_name] controllers for a traffic light control project, emphasizing signal passing between devices over a network and considering wireless networking options. Responses confirm that input/output communication via network, as well as using LAN, WLAN, or DLAN, is supported.
